document.title: MyGray – Requirements Concept (User Needs, System & Software Requirements, Risk Controls)

conventions.id_scheme: UN-nnn user need; SYS-AREA-nnn system requirement; SRS-AREA-nnn software requirement; HAZ-nnn hazard; RC-AREA-nnn risk control
conventions.test_naming: Rust test functions are named <srs id lower-case with underscores>_<behaviour>, e.g. srs_dcm_001_store_success_only_after_durable_write; `cargo xtask trace` links them.

product.name: MyGray
product.intended_purpose: MyGray is intended to collect, store, analyse and display radiation dose information (from DICOM RDSR and related objects) generated by X-ray based imaging modalities (CT, interventional/fluoroscopy, radiography, mammography) and nuclear medicine, in order to support medical physics experts and radiology staff in monitoring and optimising patient exposure, comparing with diagnostic reference levels and identifying exposures requiring follow-up. MyGray does not control any modality and does not provide a diagnosis.
product.use_environment: Hospital / imaging centre IT network, server operated by hospital IT, access via web browser on hospital workstations.
product.patient_population: All patients undergoing ionising-radiation imaging, including paediatric patients and pregnant patients.
product.contraindications: None. Not intended for real-time intra-procedural dose guidance.

regulatory.qualification: MDSW per MDCG 2019-11 (processes patient-specific data to provide information used for decisions on follow-up of patients and optimisation).
regulatory.proposed_class: IIa (Annex VIII Rule 11) – to be confirmed by Regulatory Affairs and Notified Body
regulatory.iec_62304_safety_class: B (system level; see software_items for per-item class and segregation rationale)
related_legislation: National radiation protection law (e.g. DE: StrlSchG/StrlSchV)
NIS2 / national hospital IT security rules where applicable

user_needs.statement: I need every dose report sent by a modality to be captured completely, or to be told when it was not.
I need dose values to be shown correctly with their units, per event and per study, for CT, projection X-ray and NM.
I need to compare doses against diagnostic reference levels and see trends per device/protocol.
I need to define my own alert thresholds (per modality, protocol, patient group) and be notified when they are exceeded.
I need to see a patient's cumulative dose history across devices to decide on follow-up (e.g. skin dose after interventions).
I need to be informed immediately about any technical malfunction of the system.
I need the system to be installable, configurable, backed up and restorable within hospital IT processes.
I need personal data to be protected, access to be role-based and every access to be auditable.
I need reports to fulfil legal dose documentation and DRL review obligations.
I need the system to withstand malicious or malformed network input without failing.

system_requirements.title: Receive dose objects via DICOM
system_requirements.statement: The system shall act as a DICOM Storage SCP accepting RDSR (X-Ray, Radiopharmaceutical), Enhanced SR and Secondary Capture objects.
acceptance_criteria: Conformance statement published and verified against implementation

system_requirements.title: No silent data loss
system_requirements.statement: The system shall never discard a received DICOM object without (a) informing the sending modality through a non-success DIMSE status or (b) raising an alert to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Fault-injection system tests (disk full, crash, parse error) show zero unreported losses over 100 000 objects

system_requirements.title: Extract dose metrics
system_requirements.statement: The system shall extract dose metrics from RDSR TID 10001, 10011 and 10021 into a normalised dose model.
acceptance_criteria: Reference dataset of ≥ 5 vendors per modality matches vendor console values

system_requirements.title: Persistent dose registry
system_requirements.statement: The system shall persistently store patients, studies, series, devices, dose reports, users, alerts and audit records and keep their relationships.
acceptance_criteria: All entities retrievable after restart and after backup/restore

system_requirements.title: Technical alerting
system_requirements.statement: The system shall notify configured recipients about every error and malfunction of the system.
acceptance_criteria: Each documented alert code can be triggered in test and is delivered

system_requirements.title: Configurable dose triggers
system_requirements.statement: The system shall evaluate user-configurable rules on received dose data and notify recipients when rules fire.
acceptance_criteria: Rule fires within 60 s of object receipt

system_requirements.title: Web visualisation
system_requirements.statement: The system shall provide a browser-based UI to view dose data, statistics, DRL comparisons, alerts and audit trail.

system_requirements.title: Security & privacy
system_requirements.statement: The system shall implement authentication, role-based authorisation, encryption in transit, audit logging and data minimisation.

system_requirements.title: Operability
system_requirements.statement: The system shall support installation, configuration validation, backup/restore, health monitoring and update with documented procedures.

system_requirements.title: Labelling in software
system_requirements.statement: The system shall display UDI, manufacturer, version, CE mark and access to electronic IFU.
acceptance_criteria: About page reviewed against labelling spec

software_requirements.title: Typed dose quantities
software_requirements.statement: All dose quantities shall be represented by unit-specific types that reject NaN, infinite and negative values.
acceptance_criteria: Property test over all f64 values

software_requirements.title: Fail-fast configuration
software_requirements.statement: The software shall refuse to start if the configuration is incomplete or invalid and shall report the offending field.
acceptance_criteria: Each mandatory key removed in turn → startup aborted with field name

software_requirements.title: Semantic configuration checks
software_requirements.statement: The software shall verify at startup that spool, quarantine, database and backup paths exist, are writable and support fsync.

software_requirements.title: Acknowledge only after durable write
software_requirements.statement: The DICOM node shall send C-STORE Success only after the received object and its journal record are durably written (fsync of file and directory).
acceptance_criteria: Process kill at any point after Success never loses the object (crash test, 1 000 iterations)

software_requirements.title: Integrity hash
software_requirements.statement: Each spooled object shall be stored content-addressed by SHA-256 and verified on every read.
acceptance_criteria: Bit-flip in spool file detected and alerted

software_requirements.title: Inform sender on failure
software_requirements.statement: If an object cannot be durably stored, the node shall respond with status 0xA700 (Out of Resources) and raise a Critical alert.

software_requirements.title: Crash recovery
software_requirements.statement: On startup the node shall replay every journal entry not in a terminal state.
acceptance_criteria: kill -9 during ingest of 10 000 objects → all persisted after restart

software_requirements.title: Idempotent ingest
software_requirements.statement: Receiving the same object (same SOP Instance UID and hash) again shall not create duplicates; same UID with different content shall be kept as a new version and raise a Warning.

software_requirements.title: Quarantine instead of discard
software_requirements.statement: Objects that cannot be parsed or validated shall be moved to quarantine with reason and diagnostics, retained, and alerted; removal only by audited user action.
acceptance_criteria: Corrupted corpus fully present in quarantine

software_requirements.title: Supported SOP classes
software_requirements.statement: The node shall accept Verification, X-Ray Radiation Dose SR, Radiopharmaceutical Radiation Dose SR, Enhanced SR and Secondary Capture with Implicit/Explicit VR Little Endian and Deflated transfer syntaxes.
acceptance_criteria: Conformance test with dcm4che and dicom-rs SCUs

software_requirements.title: Disk space guard
software_requirements.statement: The node shall reject new associations and raise an Error alert when free spool space falls below the configured minimum.

software_requirements.title: Concurrency limits
software_requirements.statement: The node shall handle at least 16 concurrent associations and enforce the configured maximum.
acceptance_criteria: Load test 16 parallel SCUs, no failures

software_requirements.title: Decoupled ingest
software_requirements.statement: Parsing and persistence shall run asynchronously from the association so that store latency never causes DIMSE timeouts.
acceptance_criteria: Store latency injected 10 s → C-STORE RSP < 1 s

software_requirements.title: UID validation
software_requirements.statement: DICOM UIDs shall be validated per PS3.5 §9.1; invalid UIDs shall produce a diagnostic and quarantine when mandatory.

software_requirements.title: Correct value extraction
software_requirements.statement: The parser shall extract CTDIvol, DLP, SSDE, DAP, reference air kerma, fluoroscopy time, administered activity and acquisition parameters with their units exactly as reported.

software_requirements.title: Template coverage
acceptance_criteria: Golden file per template and per major vendor

software_requirements.title: Plausibility checks
software_requirements.statement: The parser shall check consistency of accumulated vs. per-event values and physical plausibility, and emit diagnostics on deviations.

software_requirements.title: Total, panic-free parsing
software_requirements.statement: The parser shall return a result or an error for every possible input and shall never panic, overflow the stack or allocate unbounded memory.

software_requirements.title: Parsing performance
software_requirements.statement: The parser shall parse a 500-event CT RDSR in < 5 ms (p95) on reference hardware and the system shall sustain 1 000 RDSR/min ingest.
acceptance_criteria: criterion benchmark in CI, regression > 20 % fails

software_requirements.title: Lossless parsing
software_requirements.statement: Every content item of an RDSR shall either be mapped into the normalised model or retained as unmapped content; nothing shall be silently dropped.
acceptance_criteria: count(items in) == count(mapped) + count(unmapped) for all golden files

software_requirements.title: Unit conversion
software_requirements.statement: UCUM units shall be converted to canonical units exactly once; unknown units shall be rejected, never guessed.
acceptance_criteria: Table test of all UCUM units in PS3.16 dose templates

software_requirements.title: Embedded graph store
software_requirements.statement: The software shall persist all entities in an embedded Grafeo database following the documented graph schema.
acceptance_criteria: Schema test creates/reads every node and edge type

software_requirements.title: Repository round-trip
software_requirements.statement: Every repository shall store and retrieve its aggregate without loss of information.

software_requirements.title: Atomic ingest
software_requirements.statement: Persisting one dose report including patient, study, series, events and ingest record shall be one atomic transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Fault injection mid-transaction → no partial graph

software_requirements.title: Backup and restore
software_requirements.statement: The software shall provide online backup, restore and integrity verification of the database.

software_requirements.title: Safe schema migration
software_requirements.statement: Schema migrations shall be forward-only, versioned, preceded by an automatic backup, and the software shall refuse to open a database with a newer schema.
acceptance_criteria: Migration test from every released schema version

software_requirements.title: Cumulative dose queries
software_requirements.statement: The store shall provide cumulative dose per patient over a time window across all devices, and statistics per device/protocol.

software_requirements.title: All errors reportable
software_requirements.statement: Every error type of every software item shall implement the Reportable trait with a stable alert code and severity, and every error path shall report it to the alert bus.
acceptance_criteria: Static check: no `let _ =` / ignored Result on error paths (clippy + review)

software_requirements.title: Panic capture
software_requirements.statement: Panics in any thread or task shall be captured and raised as Critical alerts, and the affected task restarted by the supervisor.

software_requirements.title: Persist before notify
software_requirements.statement: Alerts shall be persisted before notification so that no alert is lost on crash.
acceptance_criteria: Crash after raise → alert present after restart

software_requirements.title: Sink fallback
software_requirements.statement: If a notification sink fails, the next configured sink shall be used; if all sinks fail the system health shall be RED and shown in the UI and health endpoint.

software_requirements.title: Supervised alert system
software_requirements.statement: The alert subsystem shall emit heartbeats; their absence shall be detectable externally via /health/ready.
acceptance_criteria: Alert task stopped → readiness fails within 30 s

software_requirements.title: Unit-safe rule evaluation
software_requirements.statement: The rule engine shall only compare values whose units are compatible with the rule threshold unit; incompatible combinations shall be rejected at rule-save time.
acceptance_criteria: mGy threshold vs DLP metric → rejected

software_requirements.title: Escalation
software_requirements.statement: Unacknowledged Critical alerts shall be re-notified after a configurable interval and escalated to the next role.

software_requirements.title: Acknowledgement
software_requirements.statement: Users with the required role shall acknowledge alerts with a mandatory comment for dose alerts; acknowledgements shall be audited.

software_requirements.title: No silent alert loss
software_requirements.statement: When the alert bus overflows, an aggregated Critical alert with the number of dropped alerts shall be raised.
acceptance_criteria: Flood test → ALR-0002 with correct count

software_requirements.title: Configurable versioned rules
software_requirements.statement: Users with role Physicist shall create, edit, enable and disable dose rules; each change shall create a new immutable, audited version.
acceptance_criteria: Edit → version n+1, old version retrievable

software_requirements.title: Rule validation
software_requirements.statement: Invalid rules (unknown metric, unit mismatch, missing window for cumulative metrics, non-finite threshold) shall be rejected with a reason.

software_requirements.title: Alert provenance
software_requirements.statement: A fired dose alert shall contain rule id, rule version, observed value with unit, threshold and the study reference.

software_requirements.title: Deterministic thresholds
software_requirements.statement: Threshold comparison shall be deterministic and correct at boundary values for all operators.

software_requirements.title: Device silence detection
software_requirements.statement: The system shall raise an alert when a device has not sent dose data for a configurable period.

software_requirements.title: Study dose view
software_requirements.statement: The UI shall show per study the irradiation events and accumulated values with units, device, protocol and DRL ratio.

software_requirements.title: Statistics & DRL
software_requirements.statement: The UI shall show distributions and trends per device/protocol compared with configured DRLs.

software_requirements.title: Unambiguous value display
software_requirements.statement: Every displayed dose value shall be shown with its unit, defined precision and locale-correct decimal separator.
acceptance_criteria: All templates use format helper (inspection + test)

software_requirements.title: Patient cumulative timeline
software_requirements.statement: The UI shall show a patient's dose history and cumulative values across devices.

software_requirements.title: System status banner
software_requirements.statement: Every page shall display the system health state and the number of unacknowledged Critical alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Banner present on all pages (test iterates routes)

software_requirements.title: Data staleness indication
software_requirements.statement: Views shall show the time of the last received object per device so that missing data is recognisable.

software_requirements.title: Authentication
software_requirements.statement: All UI routes except health probes and login shall require authentication (local argon2id accounts or LDAP/OIDC).

software_requirements.title: Session management
software_requirements.statement: Sessions shall expire after configurable idle time and be invalidated on logout; cookies Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict.

software_requirements.title: Role-based access
software_requirements.statement: Access shall be enforced per the RBAC matrix; PHI is visible only to roles that need it.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix-driven test for every role × route

software_requirements.title: Audit trail
software_requirements.statement: Logins, PHI access, exports, configuration/rule changes, acknowledgements and quarantine actions shall be recorded in the audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Each action produces exactly one audit record

software_requirements.title: Tamper-evident audit
software_requirements.statement: Audit records shall be hash-chained; chain breaks shall be detected and alerted.

software_requirements.title: Memory safety
software_requirements.statement: Production code shall contain no `unsafe` blocks; SOUP containing unsafe code is assessed in the SOUP list.

software_requirements.title: PHI at rest
software_requirements.statement: Identifying patient data shall be stored separately from dose data and encrypted at rest.
acceptance_criteria: Raw DB file contains no plaintext names

software_requirements.title: Encryption in transit
software_requirements.statement: The web UI shall be served via TLS 1.2+ only; DICOM TLS shall be supported.

software_requirements.title: HTTP hardening
software_requirements.statement: Responses shall carry CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options; state-changing requests require CSRF token; login is rate-limited.

software_requirements.title: AE whitelist
software_requirements.statement: The DICOM node shall reject associations from calling AE titles not configured as accepted devices and raise a Warning alert.

software_requirements.title: Injection-safe queries
software_requirements.statement: All database queries shall be parameterised constants; user input shall never be concatenated into GQL.

software_requirements.title: SBOM & vulnerability monitoring
software_requirements.statement: Every release shall ship a CycloneDX SBOM and pass cargo-deny advisories with no unassessed findings.
acceptance_criteria: Release bundle contains SBOM; CI deny job green

software_requirements.title: Data minimisation
software_requirements.statement: Only DICOM attributes needed for the intended purpose shall be stored in the structured model; birth date reduced to year.

software_requirements.title: No PHI in notifications/logs
software_requirements.statement: Technical logs, e-mails, webhooks and syslog messages shall not contain PHI; they reference internal ids only.
acceptance_criteria: Log scan of system test run finds no test patient names

software_requirements.title: Retention & erasure
software_requirements.statement: Retention periods shall be configurable; expired data and erasure requests shall be processed by audited pseudonymisation or deletion.
acceptance_criteria: Retention job test with mocked clock

software_requirements.title: Health endpoints
software_requirements.statement: The software shall expose /health/live and /health/ready reflecting store, spool, alert subsystem and DICOM listener state.

software_requirements.title: Graceful shutdown
software_requirements.statement: On SIGTERM the software shall stop accepting associations, drain the pipeline, flush the journal and close the store within 30 s.
acceptance_criteria: SIGTERM under load → no unfinished journal entries

software_requirements.title: About / labelling page
software_requirements.statement: The UI shall show product name MyGray, version, UDI-DI/UDI-PI, manufacturer, CE mark with NB number, and link to the eIFU.

hazards.sequence_of_events: Object received → crash/disk full/parse failure → object discarded without notice
hazards.hazardous_situation: High-dose exposure not recorded; no follow-up of patient with potential deterministic effects
hazards.harm: Delayed treatment of radiation skin injury

hazards.sequence_of_events: Rule fires / error occurs → notification channel down → nobody informed
hazards.harm: Delayed follow-up; repeated over-exposure due to unnoticed protocol error

hazards.sequence_of_events: Vendor-specific RDSR structure misinterpreted → wrong value stored
hazards.hazardous_situation: Wrong DRL comparison or missed alert
hazards.harm: Unnecessary exposure (failed optimisation) or missed follow-up

hazards.sequence_of_events: Value in Gy·m² interpreted as µGy·m² (or mGy·cm vs mGy) → factor 10³ error
hazards.hazardous_situation: Dose appears far lower/higher than actual
hazards.harm: Missed follow-up / unnecessary patient anxiety and examinations

hazards.sequence_of_events: Patient ID collision across issuers / merge error
hazards.hazardous_situation: Cumulative dose of wrong patient displayed
PHI disclosed or dose data manipulated
hazards.harm: Privacy harm; manipulated data leading to wrong decisions

hazards.hazard: Software crash / denial of service via malformed input
hazards.sequence_of_events: Malformed DICOM → panic/stack overflow → node down

risk_controls.description: Durable journal: C-STORE success only after fsync; replay on startup.
Non-success DIMSE status to sender + Critical alert on storage failure.
Quarantine + lossless parsing; nothing is deleted without audited user action.
Device silence detection and last-contact display.
Golden-file and multi-vendor reference dataset verification.
Plausibility and consistency checks with diagnostics.
Uniform Reportable error model + panic capture + supervision.
Sink fallback, health RED state, externally observable heartbeat, status banner.
Patient identity = (Patient ID, Issuer); conflicts raise alerts instead of auto-merge.
Authentication, RBAC, TLS, audit, hardening, SBOM monitoring.
Memory-safe language, `unsafe` forbidden in own code.
No implicit panics (clippy deny unwrap/expect/panic), total parser, fuzzing.
Integer overflow checks enabled in release builds.
Typed units; single conversion point; unit-checked rules.
Unit always displayed; IFU explains quantities and limitations.
